ImageDescription.value: Inscribed: ELECTRA and CHRYSOTHEMIS "Instant, my sister, thy devoted hair / "With these dishevell'd locks, and this my love / "Plain as it is and unadorne'd, shalt thou / "Bear to our Father; wretched offerings these / "But O! 'tis all Electra non can give. / Vid: Franklin's Sophocles' Electra; ActI Sc. 4 / From an Orignal picture in the Collection of Sir Edward Vernon / London: Published Apl. 20 1786 by Thos Macklin 39, Fleet Street
